title.narrative: Supporting Inclusive and Liberation Theology in El Salvador and Honduras

description.narrative:
SOMOS CDC will act in coordination with the salvadoran Ecumenical Research Center (CIE) supporting spiritual learning and accompaniment for excluded goups. They will educate grassroots ecclesial communities (CEBs) and indigenous populations on Liberation Theology, and will teach inclusive theology to feminist and LGBTIQ+ communities so that they can practice their right to religious freedom, free from any discrimination from established institutions of faith.
For the purposes of this intervention, most of the activities will take place in El Salvador and will be delivered by the CIE, while a Regional Summit and an online Diploma will be executed by both organizations in Honduras. With these actions, the project develops spaces for reflection and inclusive spirituality, thus promoting solidarity and raising the prophetic voice needed in traditional religious practice.
